date_note: Total.kz gives only its publication day, 25 November 2026; the page states no earlier date for the ratification.
title: Kazakhstan's parliament ratifies the UN Convention against Cybercrime, Total.kz reports
summary: Total.kz reports that Kazakhstan's parliament ratified the UN Convention against Cybercrime, and that Deputy Interior Minister Sanzhar Adilov briefed on it. The convention sets criminal liability for cybercrimes, procedures to preserve digital data and a 24/7 network of contact points. Officials said cooperation does not require unconditional provision of information to foreign states.
plain: Kazakhstan's parliament ratified the UN Convention against Cybercrime, which covers criminal liability, data preservation and international cooperation, Total.kz reports.
exec: Kazakhstan has ratified a UN cybercrime treaty with cross-border cooperation and a 24/7 contact network, according to Total.kz.

validation.note: Only Total.kz was read; it relays the Deputy Interior Minister's briefing.
